description:
intent=i040 snapshot=s10 branch=fixed-epidx-rest status=complete
finding location=drivers/isdn/gigaset/usb-gigaset.c:706-741 confidence=high conclusion=gigaset_probe indexes endpoint[0]/endpoint[1] of an unvalidated descriptor array (no bNumEndpoints check in the file) to size buffers and program URBs; a 0/1-endpoint M105-spoofing gadget crashes probe or feeds OOB-read values into URB setup at plug-in.
finding location=drivers/usb/atm/ueagle-atm.c:2205-2213 confidence=high conclusion=uea_boot reads actconfig->interface[0]->altsetting[0].endpoint[0].desc.bInterval with no bNumEndpoints validation and submits an interrupt URB with it; a zero-endpoint interface-0 Eagle-spoofing gadget OOB-reads descriptor memory at modem bind (plug-in).
finding location=drivers/watchdog/pcwd_usb.c:632-648 confidence=high conclusion=usb_pcwd_probe indexes endpoint[0].desc with no bNumEndpoints check (only a HID-class check precedes) and feeds the read into usb_endpoint_is_int_in, pipe setup and URB buffer sizing; a zero-endpoint gadget OOB-reads descriptor memory at plug-in.
coverage_gap=drivers/usb/core/{config,devio,driver,hcd,hub,message,devices}.c and drivers/usb/host/xhci.c accesses were only spot-checked for loop-boundedness, not exhaustively re-audited, since they are the descriptor parser itself or internal userspace-API paths.
coverage_gap=Files that access endpoint descriptors through cached usb_endpoint_descriptor pointers, usb_pipe_endpoint(), or wrapper macros other than sound/usb get_endpoint were enumerated only via the ->endpoint[ / ->endpoint + / get_endpoint greps; other wrapper names could hide further fixed-index reads.
coverage_gap=Whether the OOB-read values (bInterval, wMaxPacketSize, bEndpointAddress) in the three findings can be turned into more than a probe-time crash/DoS (e.g. mis-sized buffers later overflowed) was not traced beyond the immediate sizing/pipe-programming uses named in the reasons.
